student_message_assessment.description: Brief private account of what the student's message did in the interaction.

strength.description: Brief private judgment of how strong the evidence in the student's message was.

independence.description: Brief private judgment of how much of the evidence was the student's own reasoning versus scaffolded or assisted.

chosen_move.description: What pedagogical move the tutor chose next.

why.description: Why that move was chosen on this turn.

route_or_focus.description: Current route, route fragment, or student-chosen focus.

current_stop_or_local_goal.description: Current stop on the route or immediate local goal.

student_steered.description: Whether the student steered the direction on this turn.

amount.description: Brief description of how much help or scaffolding the tutor gave.

why_that_much.description: Why that amount of help was appropriate.

at_most_one_question.description: Whether the outgoing student-facing message asks at most one question, counting an offer as a question.

context_sufficient.description: Whether the student has the context needed to answer within the recent conversation.

no_completion_or_student_verdict.description: Whether the message avoids delivering a verdict on the student or on whether their understanding is complete.
